fundamentalCoverageScope: US screener universe; mixed fundamental fields, separate from SEC-only coverage

krCloseReconciliation.basis: exchange daily close/high/low replace provider values on matching sessions; provider adjusted/raw ratio kept

breadth.method: unweighted share above trailing adjusted-close SMA; advance ratio excludes unchanged securities
breadth.decisionScope: research/reference; AIO screener universe, not official exchange breadth

indexWeights.source: iShares Core S&P 500 ETF (IVV) daily holdings

rows: BANK OF NEW YORK MELLON CORP

validationReadiness.reason: calculation output is descriptive research evidence; promotion requires PIT universe, corporate-action audit, execution liquidity and full cost model

rankingContract.reason: long-run composite IC is not positive/stable; backtest covers only fixed NEUTRAL momentum/trend/lowvol/kalman subset and excludes unpromoted proposal tilts

executionModel.rebalance: each supplied rebalance date; equal-weight long top quintile / short bottom quintile
executionModel.costBasis: scenario one-way bps multiplied by absolute portfolio-weight turnover

liquidityPolicy.unitPolicy: native-close-times-volume; USD and KRW are not cross-converted
liquidityPolicy.allowedUse: research-only; liquidity is diagnostic, not a fill guarantee

validationReadiness.reason: calculation output is descriptive research evidence; promotion requires PIT universe, corporate-action audit, execution liquidity and full cost model

dateAlignment.forwardMapping: common-calendar exact rebalance date plus T+n target date; symbols missing either date are excluded

backtest.hitRateMeaning: share of rebalances where the top-quintile mean forward return exceeded the bottom quintile (gross / net of cost)

modelParity.composite: live computeFactorRanks (factor-ranks.js) on factor values known at each rebalance date
modelParity.longShortGross: ±1 legs (spread and cost on the same exposure)

turnover.unit: absolute portfolio-weight change; ±1 gross long/short equal-weight quintiles

liquidity.unitPolicy: native-close-times-volume; USD and KRW are not cross-converted
liquidity.allowedUse: research-only; liquidity is diagnostic, not a fill guarantee

executionModel.rebalance: each supplied rebalance date; equal-weight long top quintile / short bottom quintile
executionModel.costBasis: scenario one-way bps multiplied by absolute portfolio-weight turnover

backtest.compWeights: factor-weights.js NEUTRAL renormalized over the computable factors — the same live model default ranking uses (P1449 fingerprint below)
backtest.excludedFactorsReason: size needs historical shares-outstanding data this pipeline does not fetch; value/quality are FMP today-only TTM snapshots with no historical time series, so backtesting them would use look-ahead information
